title: Department names
statementMd:
List each department that offers courses, once.

Expected columns: `department`.

Tables: `teachers`, `courses`, `students`, `enrollments`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT DISTINCT department FROM courses;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
